stem: Which statements about a normal distribution are true? Select the two that apply.

options.text: Its mean, median and mode are equal
About 68% of values fall within one standard deviation of the mean
It is skewed to the right
Its variance always equals its mean
It can only take positive values

eli5: A normal distribution is the bell curve. It is perfectly balanced around its middle, and most values sit close to that middle.
solution:
The bell curve is symmetric with one peak, so its mean, median and mode are the same value. About 68% of values fall within one standard deviation of the mean.

It is not skewed, it extends to negative values, and its variance is a separate parameter from its mean.

verify.basis: FE Reference Handbook 10.0.1, Engineering Probability and Statistics, normal distribution. The 68% figure is also recomputed from the normal curve.

stem: Which statements about the sample standard deviation are true? Select the two that apply.

options.text: It divides the sum of squared deviations by n - 1
It has the same units as the data

eli5: The sample standard deviation is the square root of the sample variance, which divides the sum of squared deviations from the mean by n - 1. It has the same units as the data, is never negative, and is pulled upward by extreme values because deviations are squared.
solution:
Dividing by n - 1 and sharing the data's units are both true.

It cannot be negative, because it is a square root. It is the square root of the variance, not its square. Outliers increase it strongly.

verify.basis: FE Reference Handbook 10.0.1, Engineering Probability and Statistics, dispersion: sample standard deviation

stem: Two fair dice are rolled. What is the probability that the total is 7?
eli5: When all outcomes are equally likely, probability is the number of favourable outcomes divided by the total number. Two dice give 6 × 6 = 36 ordered outcomes, so count the ordered pairs that produce the total.
solution:
There are 36 equally likely outcomes. Six of them total 7: (1,6), (2,5), (3,4), (4,3), (5,2), (6,1).

P = \frac{6}{36} = 0.167.

stem: What is the area enclosed between the line y = 3x and the parabola y = x^{2}?
eli5: Set the functions equal to find where they cross; those x values are the limits. Integrate the upper function minus the lower one between them.

Area = integral from 0 to 3 of (3x - x^{2}) dx = \frac{3(3)^{2}}{2} - \frac{(3)^{3}}{3} = 13.50 - 9.00 = 4.50 square units.
